 Trabzon, Turkey – Trabzonspor, with its Egyptian star Mohamed Salah, is preparing for a new match in the European Conference League, when it hosts Scottish side Hearts on Thursday evening, as part of the second round of the league stage for the 2026-2027 season.
 Trabzonspor aims to continue its positive results, relying on Mohamed Salah as one of the team’s attacking options, after the player delivered remarkable performances during the past period in the Turkish league competitions.
 Salah is expected to start the match in Trabzonspor’s starting lineup, especially after his good performance in the last match against Besiktas, which ended with his team winning 2-0, during which the Egyptian star scored the second goal.
 Salah has 8 goals to his name in the Turkish league so far, and he has also received praise from Thomas Reis, the coach of Trabzonspor, who spoke during the pre-match press conference about the importance of having experienced players in the team, including the Egyptian star.
 Trabzonspor’s expected lineup against Hearts
 Goalkeeper: Onana.
 Defense: Wagner Peña, Chibuke Nwayo, Stefan Savic, Sidnei Luiz Cabral.
 Midfield: Ozan Tufan, Fabinho, Benjamin Bouchouari.
 Attack: Mohamed Salah, Aral Shemshir, Deo.
